null_means: Not verified yet (Rule 6). An empty array is NOT the same as null: [] asserts that a verified check found none of these formats offered, null asserts nothing was checked.
note: Import Gate I4: every element must be one of these values. Free text fails I4.

values.open_play: Drop-in sessions with rotating partners. No fixed roster and no advance booking required to join.
values.reserved_play: Courts held in advance for a named individual or group.
values.league: Organised competition over a scheduled season, with standings or divisions.
values.tournament: Bracketed events with an entry process, run as elimination or pool play.
values.lessons: Instruction by a coach, either one-to-one or as a clinic.
